note: Inputs for the car sharing and rental tab of the plan (plan/RENTAL_PLAN.md) and its charts (tools/market/rental_charts.py). Every figure carries its source. Trip costs are computed from market/trip_rates.json. Retrieved 23 November 2026.

canada_rental_revenue.note: Automotive equipment rental and leasing (NAICS 5321), Canada, operating revenue, C$ billion, as first published in each StatCan Daily release. Covers cars, vans, trucks, trailers and RVs. StatCan later revised 2022 and 2023 and states only that 2024 was 4.3% above revised 2023. 2019 is derived from the 2023 release (9.8 / 1.235).

americas_rpd.note: Hertz Americas RAC Total RPD, US$ per transaction day. 2021-2023 from the FY2023 10-K, 2024-2025 from the FY2025 10-K. Avis Americas revenue per day excluding exchange rate effects was US$70.94 (2024) and US$68.80 (2025) per its 18 February 2026 release; earlier Avis years could not be read and are left out.

americas_utilisation.note: Hertz Americas RAC vehicle utilisation, %. Same sources. Avis Americas: 68.7% (2024), 69.9% (2025).

canada_carshare.note: Canadian round-trip and one-way car sharing members and vehicles, excludes peer-to-peer. July of each year to 2016, January for 2017 and 2018. TSRC (Shaheen and Cohen) outlooks. No later series was found.
